message: Thanks! A few quick questions: (1) Roughly how much does your household earn from work in a year, before tax? (2) Is any child under 5? (3) Is anyone pregnant, or is there a baby under 1? (4) Does anyone get health insurance through a job? (5) Does anyone in the household have a disability?
reply: Somewhere between 850 thousand and 1,500 thousand a year. No, not us. I'd have to check. Hard to say. No, everyone's healthy.

summary: Ohio married family of 4, owns home, reported earnings of roughly $850k–$1.5M/year. That is far above the income limits for SNAP, WIC, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, school meals and EITC. It is also above the 400% FPL cutoff for the ACA premium tax credit. The child tax credit is phased out at this income, so there is no refundable part. No disability or senior member, so SSI doesn't apply. Nothing to recommend.
